item.tib: dbang drag 'bar ba me phreng gi rgyud las yang byang gnad kyi gces yig
item.coloph: gsang bdag pad+ma g.yung drung can gyi gnas chen rdo rje gsang brag nas dngos grub tu brnyed (rnyed) cing phyis su me sbrul hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes bzang po la bde gsal mkha' spyod khang du shog ser la dus dang gnad la sman ched phab cing yig ge'i byed po ni g.yung drung rgyal mtshan lags pas bon 'di mi nub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan lta bu yun du dar rgyas shog/
